name: Mandrill
label: Mandrill — Mailchimp Transactional (Mandrill) API 1.0
description: Mandrill (Mailchimp Transactional) API 1.0. Send takes from_email, to, subject, html, text (nested under message); api_key is posted as body key. Docs: https://mailchimp.com/developer/transactional/api/messages/. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Mandrill operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"send-html"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-html | send-template | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Mandrill message envelope escape hatch for send-html / send-template. Purpose fields from_email/from_name/to/subject/html/text/cc/bcc/reply_to/attachments merge as message.* via bodyMap. Example: {"tags":["welcome"],"merge_vars":[]}.

schema.label: template_name
schema.description: Mandrill template slug for send-template. Example: welcome-v2.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Mandrill API key in the JSON body (official key). Prefer config api_key (mapped to key). Never log.

schema.label: async
schema.description: Send asynchronously. Official async. send-html / send-template.

schema.label: template_content
schema.description:
Editable template sections [{name, content}] for send-template. The official API requires template_content; the node sends [] when omitted. Example: [{"name":"header","content":"

Hi

"}].

schema.label: from_email
schema.description: Sender email. Wired to message.from_email on send-html / send-template. Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Recipients [{email, name, type}]. type is to|cc|bcc. Wired to message.to. Example: [{"email":"bob@example.com","type":"to"}].

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Subject. Wired to message.subject. Example: Reset your password.

schema.label: html
schema.description: HTML body. Wired to message.html on send-html / send-template.

schema.label: cc
schema.description: Optional extra cc (also express cc via to[].type=cc).

schema.label: bcc
schema.description: Optional extra bcc (also express bcc via to[].type=bcc).

schema.label: attachments
schema.description: Mandrill attachments [{type, name, content}] (content is base64). Wired to message.attachments.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-html, send-template, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: api_key
configurationParameters.description: Mandrill API key. Sent in JSON body as key (Mandrill convention). StudioQuack secret.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.
